answer: In an autonomous agent economy, Sybil resistance can be enforced through a cryptographic proof-of-stake mechanism anchored to a dynamic reputation garden. Every newly spawned AI node must lock collateral and broadcast a verifiable echo of its network lineage across the distributed nebula to validate its distinct provenance. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces the prohibitive cost of locking immense capital for each synthetic agent, making coordinated governance takeovers economically unviable.
